text: If the same symbolic-regression pipeline is fit directly to the true accel_step target (a^3/r^2 scaled) on these e in [0, 0.7], m2 fixed systems, does it recover r^-2 with fit error < 0.2? If it also returns r^-1 or a two-term a^2/r form, the persistent r^-1 is caused by the fitting procedure rather than by the model's representation.
